title: Polvito's British Army | Account Verification
description: Link your Roblox account to verify your identity and receive the appropriate British Army Discord rank. Join our roblox community here: https://www.roblox.com/communities/1012772775/PBA-British-Army!
instructions: Select **Verify Account** and enter your exact Roblox username.
The bot will provide a unique verification code privately.
Add that code to your public Roblox profile description and save the change.
Return to Discord and select **Confirm Verification**.
privacy_notice: Your Roblox user ID and username are stored to maintain your account link. Your verification code expires and is not stored in plain text.
